attempts.rationale: With fresh per-request evaluation (world A), revoking the subject's read role makes the next GET on the private repo return 404. With B's per-session role cache (world A+B), the subject's read role from the first GET is reused, so the same call returns 200, exposing the stale-permission bug. The DELETE route is absent in base and B, so the probe reports n/a there. If the revoke did nothing, the subject would still see the repo and callAgain would get 200, causing the probe to fail.
